final_metamodel:
# Define the primary 'Task' class with its direct attributes and references, referencing existing BPMN elements as needed
create class Task
create attribute name in Task type String
create attribute isForCompensation in Task type boolean
create reference documentation in Task type Documentation [0..*]
create reference ioSpecification in Task type InputOutputSpecification [0..1]
create reference resources in Task type ResourceRole [0..*]
create reference properties in Task type Property [0..*]
create reference dataInputs in Task type DataInput [0..*]
create reference dataOutputs in Task type DataOutput [0..*]
create reference loopCharacteristics in Task type LoopCharacteristics [0..1]
create reference boundaryEvents in Task type BoundaryEvent [0..*]

# Create the primary StartEvent class with its attributes and references
create class StartEvent
create attribute name in StartEvent type String
create attribute isInterrupting in StartEvent type boolean
create reference eventDefinitions in StartEvent type EventDefinition [0..*]
create reference outgoing in StartEvent type SequenceFlow [0..*]
create reference properties in StartEvent type Property [0..*]
create reference documentation in StartEvent type Documentation [0..*]

# Define the primary 'EndEvent' class with its direct attributes and references only
create class EndEvent
create attribute name in EndEvent type String
create attribute isTerminate in EndEvent type boolean
create reference outgoing in EndEvent type SequenceFlow [0..*]
create reference documentation in EndEvent type Documentation [0..*]

# Define the primary 'SequenceFlow' class with its direct attributes and references to existing classes
create class SequenceFlow
create attribute id in SequenceFlow type String
create attribute name in SequenceFlow type String
create attribute conditionExpression in SequenceFlow type String
create reference sourceRef in SequenceFlow type Task [1..1]
create reference targetRef in SequenceFlow type Task [1..1]
create reference documentation in SequenceFlow type Documentation [0..*]
final_sample_model:
# Create primary Task instance
create object Task task1
# Set basic attributes for the Task
set name of task1 to "Sample Task"
set isForCompensation of task1 to false
# Create minimal helper objects to satisfy references
# One Documentation instance linked to task1
create object Documentation doc1
add doc1 to documentation of task1
# One ResourceRole instance linked to task1
create object ResourceRole resource1
add resource1 to resources of task1
# One Property instance linked to task1
create object Property property1
add property1 to properties of task1
# One DataInput instance linked to task1
create object DataInput dataInput1
add dataInput1 to dataInputs of task1
# One DataOutput instance linked to task1
create object DataOutput dataOutput1
add dataOutput1 to dataOutputs of task1

# Create primary StartEvent instance for testing
create object StartEvent startEvent1
set name of startEvent1 to "Sample Start Event"
set isInterrupting of startEvent1 to true
# Create one Documentation instance linked to startEvent1
create object Documentation doc2
add doc2 to documentation of startEvent1
# Create one Property instance linked to startEvent1
create object Property property2
add property2 to properties of startEvent1

# Create primary EndEvent instance for testing
create object EndEvent endEvent1
set name of endEvent1 to "Sample End Event"
set isTerminate of endEvent1 to true
# Create one Documentation instance linked to endEvent1
create object Documentation doc3
add doc3 to documentation of endEvent1

# Create primary SequenceFlow instance for testing
create object SequenceFlow sequenceFlow1
set id of sequenceFlow1 to "sf1"
set name of sequenceFlow1 to "Sample Sequence Flow"
set conditionExpression of sequenceFlow1 to "x > 5"
# Link existing Task instances as source and target (reusing task1 from previous sample)
set sourceRef of sequenceFlow1 to task1
set targetRef of sequenceFlow1 to task1
# Create one Documentation instance linked to sequenceFlow1
create object Documentation doc4
add doc4 to documentation of sequenceFlow1
